topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The walls that have held my life seem to shift, the spaces I knew reshaping without my touch. Strangers with eager eyes and quick hands measure the corners where my dreams have dwelled. Every whisper of change floats like dust through the air, each particle a promise of the unknown. The familiar hum of the place is now a chorus of plans and possibilities that do not sing my song. I find myself lingering in the shadows, hands clutching the edges of my memories, questioning the path ahead as the ground beneath me feels less sure.
